newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen opening up, helped by data.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen opening up, helped by data.

text.p: Wall Street was expected to open higher on Thursday, boosted by an increase in weekly jobless claims and a narrower-than-expected international trade gap in April, analysts said.
"Those numbers are likely to contribute to a decent day for equities," said Alan Ackerman, market strategist at Fahnestock & Co.
The U.S. Treasury 30-year bond was up 7/32 to yield 6.67 percent, and the Standard & Poors 500 futures index was up 3.40 to 902.70.
